en: Revenue rose 12% to $201.9B, just short of the ~$202.2B consensus, and EPS of $1.89 missed $1.97; moving Prime Day into Q2 cost about 4 points of growth. AWS accelerated for a sixth quarter to 39.3% ($46.0B, 38.7% margin) with a $578B backlog, and operating margin hit a record 13.9%. CEO Andy Jassy projected AWS growth above 40% in 2027 and 2028 and said capex will rise meaningfully next year. The Q4 guide of $240–247B brackets the ~$244.5B consensus.

Shares fell 4.3% to $243.79 in the session before the report as Alphabet's slide hit AI spenders, then dropped about 7% after hours. On Oct 30 they opened near $232 but clawed back to close down 1.4% at $240.35, ahead of a Nasdaq down 2.9%, as analysts focused on AWS's fastest growth in nearly five years and the 40%-plus outlook. Most kept Buy ratings; BofA, TD Cowen and Cantor trimmed targets on about $220B of 2026 capex and negative free cash flow.
zh: 营收增长 12% 至 2,019 亿美元，略低于约 2,022 亿美元的一致预期；每股收益 1.89 美元，不及 1.97 美元。Prime Day 移至第二季拖累增速约 4 个百分点。AWS 连续第六个季度加速，增长 39.3%（460 亿美元，利润率 38.7%），积压订单 5,780 亿美元；营业利润率创纪录达 13.9%。CEO 安迪·贾西预计 AWS 在 2027 和 2028 年增速均超 40%，并称明年资本开支将明显增加。第四季营收指引 2,400–2,470 亿美元，涵盖约 2,445 亿的一致预期。

财报前一交易日，Alphabet 大跌拖累 AI 投资大户，股价下跌 4.3% 至 243.79 美元，盘后再跌约 7%。10 月 30 日开盘约 232 美元，随后收复大部分跌幅，收跌 1.4% 至 240.35 美元，好于下跌 2.9% 的纳指；分析师关注 AWS 近五年来最快的增速以及 2027–28 年逾 40% 的增长展望。多数机构维持买入评级，美银、TD Cowen 和 Cantor 因 2026 年约 2,200 亿美元资本开支和负自由现金流小幅下调目标价。

bio.en: Joined Amazon in 1997, wrote the plan for AWS and ran it from its 2006 launch until 2021, when he succeeded Jeff Bezos as CEO. Now running a capex program of roughly $200B a year, mostly for AI capacity.
bio.zh: 1997 年加入亚马逊，撰写了 AWS 的商业计划，并从 2006 年推出一直执掌至 2021 年，随后接替贝索斯出任 CEO。目前主导每年约 2,000 亿美元的资本开支，主要用于 AI 算力。

bio.en: CFO since 2015. Joined Amazon in 2002 and was CFO of its global consumer business; earlier finance roles at Fisher Scientific and BFGoodrich.
bio.zh: 2015 年起任 CFO。2002 年加入亚马逊，曾任全球消费者业务 CFO；更早在 Fisher Scientific 和 BFGoodrich 担任财务职务。
